editorial:
Imagine you are hanging out with your best friends on a group video call when suddenly, one of them just disappears right in front of your eyes. That is exactly how things kick off for Sam and her group. You will feel the tension build up quickly as the friends try to figure out where she went. It starts as a weird mystery, but it quickly turns into a nightmare. The movie does a great job of making you feel like you are right there on the screen with them, and the scary parts really sneak up on you when you least expect it.

The acting feels very real, and the way the story moves keeps you on the edge of your seat. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the scares are top-notch and the pacing never slows down. If you love movies that use technology to freak you out, you need to see this.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the force taking the friends is a digital entity that lives inside their internet connection. In the final scene, the last survivor realizes the entity cannot be stopped by turning off the computer. It actually jumps from the screen into the real world. The movie ends with the survivor looking into a mirror and seeing the entity standing right behind them, showing that no one is safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves screen-life movies and supernatural mysteries.
